essence: Uttering klīṃ followed by svāhā constitutes the mantra in question.
One should meditate on the deer-eyed, nine-essenced goddess who grants brahman-bliss.
Honey-flowers are presented as an alternative offering material.
One should recite the mantra on the bright eighth day in a solitary, secluded place.
Following the prior method, one should perform nine thousand recitations.
